<div class="card-body">
'''Sense (Dark) (Premiere)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">感知</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。１：運命数を引き、運命数＜（場に出ている中で、最も能力値の高い自分のキャラクターの能力値）であれば、インタラプト（か“リアクション”）を１つキャンセルする。２：今使用されたばかりの「意識操作」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-267o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「なにかを感じる。久しく触れることのなかったなにかを…」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sense.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. 1. Draw destiny. If it is less than the ability of your highest-ability character on table, cancel one Interrupt or react. 2. Cancel an Alter that has just been used.

'''Lore:''' “I sense something. Something I haven't felt in a long time…”
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sense (Dark) (Premiere)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
